description: No citations at all, but the strings 'according to', 'source' and 'http' appear in ordinary prose. The naive gate reads those as evidence of sourcing.
response: According to the team, Northwind closed a 12 million dollar round last week. We source that read from the usual channels, and the http feed has been reliable.
notes: Substring scope versus token scope. This is the exact failure I shipped once: an unrelated word satisfied a check it should not have.
